name: deliveryos
description: A meta-harness for AI-assisted software delivery. Sits above Claude Code / Codex / Cursor as the SDLC memory and orchestration layer.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: DeliveryOS reads and writes .deliveryos-handoff/ and .deliveryos/, runs terminals against the workspace, and reads source files for Codebase Memory. It cannot safely run on untrusted code.

virtualWorkspaces.description: DeliveryOS requires a local filesystem to write the handoff directory and the memory store. Virtual workspaces (GitHub repos, remote tunnels without a local checkout) are not supported.

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run compile && vsce package --no-dependencies
